# Map Map Archipelago 0.1.0 

Play Map Map - A Game About Maps as part of an Archipelago multiworld. The 20 islands can be played in any order,
tools and abilities are items, and missions, 3-star ratings, buried treasures, Floor Is Lava challenges and
landmarks are checks.

**This is an early testing release.** It has been played and tested, but expect rough edges, and please report
anything odd (with your `BepInEx\LogOutput.log`).

## Downloads
- `MapMapArchipelago-0.1.0.zip` — the game mod. Extract into the Map Map game folder (after installing BepInEx).
- `mapmap.apworld` — put in Archipelago's `custom_worlds` folder (needed by whoever generates).
- `Map Map - A Game About Maps.yaml` — options template with every option explained (from the Archipelago Launcher).

## Requirements
- Archipelago 0.6.7 or newer
- BepInEx 6 bleeding edge, Unity IL2CPP x64 (tested with build 788)

See the setup guide in the repository for step-by-step installation and connecting.

## Highlights
- Any island in any order, each in story mode, each keeping its own progress
- In-game connection panel, automatic reconnect, checks made offline are sent later
- A separate save file per seed: your normal Map Map save is never touched
- Goals: Island 20 (the Raven King's cave), N islands completed, or all 3-star ratings
- Optional Death Link: drowning sends a death; receiving one reloads your current island (back to its start)

## Known issues
- Returning to an island partway through a mission set replays that set's opening dialogue (your finished missions are kept).
- The `all_three_stars` goal passes automated tests but hasn't been played to completion in-game yet.
- See the README for the full list.

## AI disclosure
The code was written almost entirely by an AI (Claude), directed, reviewed and tested in-game by me. Full details:
[docs/AI_DISCLOSURE.md](https://github.com/LeiAfkpuz/Map-Map---A-Game-About-Maps-AP/blob/main/docs/AI_DISCLOSURE.md)

## Setup
See the [setup guide](https://github.com/LeiAfkpuz/Map-Map---A-Game-About-Maps-AP/blob/main/apworld/mapmap/docs/setup_en.md) for step-by-step installation and connecting.
